New message in #sales:

dave: @lobu who owns the Globex account these days?

content.thinking:
The user is asking about who owns the Globex account. This appears to be a question about CRM data - account ownership. Let me check what tools or data sources I have available to answer this.

Looking at my available tools, I only have `send_message`. I don't have any tools to look up CRM data, query databases, or search account information.

I should let Dave know that I don't have the ability to look up account ownership information.

arguments.text: Hey Dave — I don't have access to look up account ownership data, so I can't pull up who owns Globex right now. Someone with access to the CRM (or the sales team) should be able to find that in the account record. If you can give me a tool or integration to query accounts, I'd be happy to help next time!
